prince-george.title: 9 people running for mayor in Prince George, the most of any B.C. city
prince-george.description: With nominations closed for the upcoming municipal elections, Prince George has emerged as the B.C. city with the most candidates for mayor. There are no party candidates in the race for mayor or council, but clusters of support can be seen in the nomination papers.

prince-george.title: Suspect airlifted to hospital in critical condition after weekend break-in at B.C. Hydro substation
prince-george.description: Prince George RCMP say one suspect has been taken to hospital after a break and enter at a B.C. Hydro substation north of Crystal Lake Road on Sunday.
